title: Min Stack
summary: Implement a stack with push, pop, top and getMin.

contractDetails.constraints: At most 30,000 method calls after construction. Push values fit signed 32-bit integers. Pop, top and getMin only occur on nonempty stacks. The judge sends rows [0, value] for push, [1] for pop, [2] for top and [3] for getMin. The output array records top and getMin results in call order.

statement: Implement a stack with push, pop, top and getMin. A new stack starts empty. Push adds a value, pop removes the newest value, top reads that value, and getMin reads the smallest value still present. Each operation must take constant time.

examples.explanation: Removing 3 restores the previous minimum of 9.
One copy of −8 remains after pop.
The most recent value and the minimum can differ.

constraints: At most 30,000 method calls after construction. Push values fit signed 32-bit integers. Pop, top and getMin only occur on nonempty stacks. The judge sends rows [0, value] for push, [1] for pop, [2] for top and [3] for getMin. The output array records top and getMin results in call order.
hints: Conceptual: Removing the smallest value should reveal what the minimum was just before it arrived.
Directional: Keep the minimum so far beside each stack value.
Implementation: On push, store the smaller of the new value and the previous minimum. On pop, discard both fields together.
complexityAnalysis: O(1) time per method and O(n) auxiliary space for n active entries. Each entry stores one value and one minimum.
